title: Mount Thor Raises $45M to Build Mac Data Centers for AI Agents
dek: The startup rents macOS fleets so AI agents can use real Apple computers.

facts.label: Raised across Seed and Series A
Unified memory in M5 Ultra Mac Studio

caption:
The next big Mac user might not be a person at all. It might be an AI agent. 🖥️

Mount Thor, a San Francisco startup founded in 2026, just raised $45 million across Seed and Series A rounds to build Mac data centers for AI agents. CRV and Conviction co-led the Series A, with angels from OpenAI, Meta, Cognition and Vercel joining in.

The idea: computer-use agents need real machines, and many tools only run on macOS. Mount Thor rents bare-metal Macs and macOS virtual machines on Apple silicon for agent sandboxes, reinforcement learning training, app testing and open-source model inference.

We're tracking how AI infrastructure is reshaping around agents here at AI Parabellum. Would you trust an AI agent with its own Mac?

post_caption:
Apple hardware is becoming AI infrastructure. Mount Thor's $45M raise funds rentable macOS fleets where AI agents can train, test and work, plus an inference lab for open-source models on Apple silicon.

Unlike AWS or MacStadium, its customers are AI labs and agent platforms, not human developers.
